name: Data Preview Kernel Plant

business_logic: 1. watch() pada route param id (immediate: true) menentukan mode: id kosong → loadList(), id ada → loadDetail(id)
2. loadList(): set dateFilter=todayLocalDateString(), searchFilter='', lalu kernelPlantRecordRepo.getAllRecords(userId) — seluruh record milik user, status apapun
3. filteredRecords computed: filter by date (item.date.slice(0,10) === dateFilter jika dateFilter diisi) DAN by keyword (kernel_plant_id.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) jika searchFilter diisi)
4. onItemClick(item): draft_ongoing/draft_paused → navigate ke kernel-plant-form dengan id; saved/synced → navigate ke route ini sendiri dengan id (masuk mode detail)

5. loadDetail(id): kernelPlantRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(id) — null → detailNotFound=true; else set detailRecord + detailRows (berapapun jumlahnya, urut time_slot dari repo — REVISI 2026-08-24: TIDAK lagi selalu 24, mengikuti jumlah baris yang ditambahkan user via 'Tambah baris' di Form Kernel Plant)
6. onBack(): mode detail → navigate ke route ini sendiri tanpa id (kembali ke list); mode list → navigate ke monitor-kernel-plant

data_operations.description: SELECT seluruh record milik user (mode list) atau satu record by id (mode detail)
SELECT seluruh baris (berapapun jumlahnya) terkait record, urut time_slot (mode detail)

edge_case_handling.handling: empty-state dengan pesan 'Tidak ada data yang cocok dengan filter' + tombol Reset Filter (mengosongkan dateFilter dan searchFilter)

edge_case_handling.condition: Belum ada data Kernel Plant sama sekali (list kosong tanpa filter aktif)
edge_case_handling.handling: empty-state dengan pesan 'Belum ada data kernel plant.'

edge_case_handling.condition: id tidak ditemukan di local storage (mode detail)
edge_case_handling.handling: detailNotFound=true, pesan 'Data kernel plant tidak ditemukan.' ditampilkan
navigate ke kernel-plant-form, BUKAN masuk mode detail read-only layar ini

edge_case_handling.condition: Record di mode detail memiliki nol baris Kernel Plant Detail (kasus tepi: tersimpan tanpa baris apapun)
edge_case_handling.handling: Grid menampilkan pesan/empty state (kernel-plant-detail-rows-empty), bukan error -- header dan tabel Target Operasional tetap dirender normal

business_rules_applied: Filter tanggal default hari ini saat list dimuat
Status draft mengarah ke Form Kernel Plant; status saved/synced mengarah ke mode detail layar ini sendiri
Mode detail selalu read-only, tanpa aksi edit
Grid Kernel Plant Detail menampilkan persis baris yang tersimpan pada record (revisi 2026-08-24: tidak lagi selalu 24 baris)

unit_test_cases.expect: only today-dated record rendered in the list

unit_test_cases.description: shows empty state when there are no local records
unit_test_cases.given: getAllRecords() resolves with an empty array

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to Form Kernel Plant when a draft/pause item is tapped
unit_test_cases.given: a record with status=draft_ongoing is in the filtered list, tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: router push to kernel-plant-form with that record's id

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to detail mode when a saved/synced item is tapped
unit_test_cases.given: a record with status=saved is in the filtered list, tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: router push to data-preview-kernel-plant with that record's id as param

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to Monitor Kernel Plant when Back is pressed in list mode
unit_test_cases.given: component mounted in list mode (no id param)

unit_test_cases.description: renders the record read-only with all of its detail rows (however many, a full 24 when all canonical slots were added) ordered by canonical time-slot
unit_test_cases.given: route param id set, getDraftWithDetails() resolves with a record and 24 detail rows
unit_test_cases.expect: kernel-plant-detail-rows-list rendered with 24 kernel-plant-detail-row-* items; operational-target-table renders 6 rows and 3 columns

unit_test_cases.description: renders only the rows that actually exist when a record has fewer than 24 detail rows
unit_test_cases.given: route param id set, getDraftWithDetails() resolves with a record and only 2 detail rows
unit_test_cases.expect: kernel-plant-detail-rows-list rendered with exactly 2 kernel-plant-detail-row-* items, no assumption of 24

unit_test_cases.description: shows an empty-state message (not an error) for the Kernel Plant Detail grid when the found record has zero detail rows
unit_test_cases.given: route param id set, getDraftWithDetails() resolves with a record and an empty details array
unit_test_cases.expect: kernel-plant-detail-rows-empty element rendered, header and operational-target-table still render normally

unit_test_cases.description: shows 'record tidak ditemukan' when the record is not found
unit_test_cases.given: route param id set, getDraftWithDetails() resolves null

unit_test_cases.description: renders Checked By and Acknowledged By read-only regardless of the current role
unit_test_cases.given: detail record has checked_by/acknowledged_by set, current user role is operator
unit_test_cases.expect: both fields rendered with their stored values, not blanked by role

unit_test_cases.description: navigates back to list mode (not Monitor Kernel Plant) when Back is pressed in detail mode
unit_test_cases.given: component mounted in detail mode (id param set)
unit_test_cases.expect: Back click pushes to data-preview-kernel-plant with no id param

screen_dependencies.reason: Load Data membuka layar ini; Back dari mode list kembali ke Monitor Kernel Plant
Item draft/pause pada mode list mengarah ke Form Kernel Plant

implementation_notes: Semua operasi dilakukan lokal di SQLite via kernelPlantRecordRepo.ts, tidak ada panggilan API

Mode ditentukan oleh keberadaan route param id via watch() immediate:true, bukan onMounted sekali saja — Vue Router menggunakan ulang instance komponen ini untuk navigasi antar-param pada route record yang sama

Grid detail mode-detail dirender langsung dari kolom tersimpan (findings/downtime_minutes/7 kolom numerik), tanpa perhitungan ulang — data historis; jumlah baris yang dirender sepenuhnya mengikuti `details.length` dari getDraftWithDetails(), tidak pernah diasumsikan 24

TIDAK ADA perubahan fungsional pada layar ini akibat revisi 2026-08-24 (grid dinamis di Form Kernel Plant), karena layar ini sejak awal sudah dirancang menampilkan 'seluruh baris yang ada' dan sudah punya empty-state untuk grid kosong — hanya doc comment/wording di kode dan artifact ini yang diperbarui untuk mencerminkan pola baru secara eksplisit
